article.title: Google推出Gemini 4 Hydrogen，免費App按問題自動選用
article.summary: Google公布Gemini 4 Hydrogen開始推出，面向日常代理任務，並提供Gemini API和AI Studio入口。
highlights: Gemini App免費用戶可在適合的問題由系統自動選用模型。
Google Sheets的接入視乎訂閱資格。
article.why: 行銷團隊可用同一批任務比較模型，並按錯誤類型決定哪些輸出需要審閱。
article.next_step: 用相同的素材分類或活動簡報樣本，核對輸出準確性、等待時間及審稿量。
article.detail: Google把Gemini 4 Hydrogen定位為支援日常代理工作的模型，並列出開發者、企業和消費者的不同入口。Gemini免費用戶在適合的問題由系統自動選用，Sheets接入則視乎訂閱。團隊可先用同一批低風險任務比較輸出，記錄錯誤類型及人工修訂時間。
article.title_en: Google introduces Gemini 4 Hydrogen with automatic selection for eligible free-app prompts
article.summary_en: Google announced the rollout of Gemini 4 Hydrogen for everyday agent workflows, including through the Gemini API and AI Studio.
highlights_en: The free Gemini app can select the model automatically when appropriate to the prompt.
Access in Google Sheets depends on subscription eligibility.
article.why_en: Marketing teams can compare models on the same tasks and use error patterns to decide what needs review.
article.next_step_en: Use the same tagging or campaign brief samples to compare accuracy, waiting time and review workload.
article.detail_en: Google positions Gemini 4 Hydrogen for everyday agent workflows and lists separate developer, enterprise and consumer access routes. Free Gemini app users get automatic selection when appropriate, while Sheets access depends on subscription. Start with the same low-risk tasks and record error types and manual editing time.
article.section: AI 大模型 & 市場動態
